published_b4_scores.kind: one rounded scalar anomaly score per official token

input_availability.local_cache_search: No Qwen3-Embedding-4B or embedding cache found under /home/achim/.cache/huggingface/hub before download.

regeneration_route.environment: task-scoped .venv-b5; PyTorch XPU wheel plus upstream-pinned transformers 5.2.0/tokenizers 0.22.2
regeneration_route.route: download the immutable model revision once; encode the frozen 30 dev pairs at layer 20 on xpu; persist official-token maps, fp16 embeddings and fp32 cosine matrices; run every matcher on those identical matrices
regeneration_route.upstream_reproduction_gap: The upstream published predictions name the model and layer but do not record the model repository revision used. Agreement of regenerated M0 with published rounded B4 scores is therefore an empirical comparability check, not assumed identity.

resource_check_before_download.estimated_task_disk: model 7.51 GiB; XPU Python environment <= 8 GiB; embeddings/similarities/evidence <= 1 GiB; total ceiling 17 GiB
resource_check_before_download.phases: dependency install <=25 min; model download <=35 min; 30-document encoding <=45 min; matching/evaluation <=15 min
stop_conditions: XPU unavailable after one supported-wheel installation attempt
model does not fit local accelerator/RAM
encoding cannot finish inside the wall-time ceiling
regenerated M0 lacks complete finite 30/30 official-token coverage

common.cosine: L2-normalized layer-20 subword hidden states; negative similarities clamped to zero
common.official_token_projection: arithmetic mean of each official token's subword anomaly scores

frozen_methods.M1: reciprocal nearest neighbor; real top-1 margin=max1-max2; confidence=max1*(0.75+0.25*mutual)*(0.75+0.25*margin), anomaly=1-confidence
frozen_methods.M2: one-to-one maximum-weight Hungarian assignment with a private NULL for each subword; NULL threshold 0.35; real anomaly=1-assigned cosine, NULL anomaly=1
frozen_methods.M3: single best Smith-Waterman local sequence alignment with affine gaps; match score=cosine-0.35, gap-open=-0.20, gap-extend=-0.05; aligned anomaly=1-cosine, unaligned=NULL anomaly=1

predeclared_gate.coverage: 30/30 documents, every official token finite; no coverage reduction
predeclared_gate.selection: highest full-sample macro among M1-M3 only if it clears both baselines by at least +0.005; no parameter tuning

safety.repair_budget: one primary implementation and at most one focused repair
